Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an interpretative error in the initial analysis by assuming the longest win streak in MLB history included ties, without clarifying the requirement for consecutive wins-only streaks. This led to the pursuit of verifying a 26-game streak that included a tie, rather than the uninterrupted 22-game streak by the Cleveland Indians in 2017, which holds the record for the longest consecutive wins-only streak in the regular season.
